```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readODS)
```

```{r read data}
scores <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-scores-by-small-area.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip  = 3
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lsoa_code))

cat("Loaded:", nrow(scores), "rows |", ncol(scores), "\n")

```

```{r scores_ranges}
# all domains are standarised 0-100 range looks same and cannot be discriminated between domain 
scores  %>%
  pivot_longer(4:12, names_to = "domain",values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(domain)%>%
  summarise(
    min = round(min(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    median = round(median(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    max = round(max(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
```{r worst_score}
# domain with highest score most deprived per LSOA
#capture lsoa_col name before pivot for avoiding reference error
lsoa_col    <- names(scores)[1]
domain_cols <- names(scores)[5:12]

scores %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(domain_cols), names_to = "domain", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(.data[[lsoa_col]]) %>%
  slice_max(score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(domain, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))

  
```





```{r score_correlations}
# score confirm same pattern as rank
round(cor(scores[4:12], use = "complete.obs"), 2)


```
